 Confirmed line-ups: Spurs vs Ipswich Town
 4h ago 
 -->
 We can now confirm the line-ups for our Premier League clash with Ipswich Town (kick-off 3pm).
 Roberto De Zerbi has made six changes to the side that started our narrow defeat at Leeds United just before the international break.
 Micky van de Ven, Andy Robertson, Mathys Tel, Archie Gray, Sandro Tonali and Omar Marmoush all step out of the team with Marcos, Senesi, Conor Gallagher, James Maddison, Destiny Udogie, Dominic Solanke and Luca Williams-Barnett - the latter making his full senior debut - all coming into the XI.
 Starting XI: Kinsky, Senesi, van Hecke, Gallagher, Maddison, Udogie, Fernandes, Solanke, Kudus, Pedro Porro (c), Williams-Barnett.
 Substitutes: Dubravka, Robertson, Gray, Bergvall, Savio, Kulusevski, Marmoush, Bentancur, van de Ven.
 -->
 Here's how the visitors line up...
 Starting XI: Walton, Furlong, Davis, Diop, Flemming, Enciso, Lukic, Palacios, O'Shea (c), Maeda, Outttara.
 Substitutes: Scherpen, Matusiwa, Fatawu, Philogene, Florentino, Emersonn, Greaves, Akpom, Clarke.
